protocol.development_run: v1 seeds 101–110 showed logistic was stronger after a context switch. The production council now includes that existing alternative; v2 uses new seeds and reports both outcomes.
protocol.scoring: Next-side forecast stored before the following outcome; all models may update after scoring. Warmup excluded equally.
protocol.scope: Synthetic recurring-context and context-switch tasks; statistical forecast component. No live-market, whole-organism, consciousness or neural-plasticity inference.
protocol.neural_probability: 0.5 for every sample; no fabricated spike features. Production also supplies its separate spike readout.
protocol.success_rule: Report every task, seed and comparator. A mean win is not a win on every task. Negative and null results remain in the output.

legacy_correction.conclusion: Simple predictor matches accuracy and has lower probability error; no neural advantage established.
